name: Something with a Lid
summary: Exethanter, the forgetful lich of the Amber Temple, has lost his phylactery. He hid it very cleverly.

stages.journal: Exethanter, the last warden of the Amber Temple, has lost 'a thing with a lid': his phylactery, without which he would not come back if destroyed. He hid it so cleverly that he can't find it. He thinks it's somewhere sensible.
On the top shelf of Exethanter's own study: a clay jar, sealed with wax, labelled in his hand NOT THE PHYLACTERY.
objectives: Decide what to do with the jar

stages.journal: We gave Exethanter his phylactery. He tucked it inside his robe, thanked us, and promised to remember why.
We kept Exethanter's phylactery, 'for safekeeping'. He understood exactly what that meant, and has become very cooperative.
We smashed Exethanter's phylactery. When this body fails, he will not come back. He thanked us, and asked us to leave him alone for a while.
